title: 第23章 龙血寒玉床第24章 算你狠
lines: 并未回洞府，林铮直接前往云潮院。
“师父！”
“师父！”
“别叫了，你师父没有死，不需要叫魂。”
看着如鬼魅出现在自己面前的火玄，林铮有些着急的问道：“师父，你是否听说过净梵果和苦竹。”
火玄皱起眉头，想了想说道：“净梵果我听过，但你所说的苦竹，却是从未听说，你有用？”
林铮点点头，实话实说道：“我得到的血菩提，需要配合净梵果和苦竹一起融合，才能不保证被血菩提反噬。”
“谁告诉你的？”
“黎家主。”
只能推给黎家主，不可能泄露塔灵的身份。
“苦竹我不知道，但净梵果太难寻得，我会帮你留意。”
“多谢师父。”
“咦？你又突破了？”
“侥幸。”
狠狠瞪了林铮一眼，火玄笑着说道：“你小子的天赋怎么这么好，三重筑基境，按照你的修炼速度，说不定一年后，便有机会开始凝轮。”
就在此时。
“火玄长老，你有空吗？”
一位身材高挑，全身蓝色紧身衣包裹的女子突然走了进来，剑眉星眸，高挺的鼻梁下是一张樱桃小嘴，英姿飒爽，好像从战场上下来的女将军。
“原来是颜霓，这次又想炼制什么丹药。”
“破轮丹。”
听到破轮丹，火玄显得很是惊讶，问道：“炼制破轮丹的药材都凑齐了？”
颜霓点点头，手里出现一个个玉盒，大概有着十几个，说道：“这次外出，总算是皇天不负苦心人，被我凑齐了所有药材，希望火玄长老能帮我炼制出破轮丹。”
火玄点点头，说道：“三天后来取。”
“多谢。”
放下玉盒，颜霓转身离去。
“别看了，她不适合你。”
“师父，你为老不尊。”
火玄笑着说道：“她叫颜霓，湮鼎宗的大师姐，八重凝轮境，这次得到破轮丹，相信可以突破到九重凝轮境，半年内应该可以开始冲击归一境了。”
“师父，破轮丹品级很高吗？”
“天级凡品，每位凝轮境武者都可以借助破轮丹提升一个阶位，没有任何副作用，但只能吞服一枚。”
凡品分四级，天地玄黄。
天级凡品丹药，已经是凡品最高品级，再往上便是灵品丹药了。
“你随我进来。”
“师父，我现在还无法炼制天级凡品丹药。”
“废话，我当然知道，你进来观摩，对你炼丹有好处。”
三天后。
颜霓早早的来到云潮院，很是期待，她只要能够吞服破轮丹，修为便可以顺利晋级到九重凝轮境，距离归一境又近了一步。
咯吱，石门开启。
火玄带着林铮从炼丹房走了出来。
“火玄长老，怎么样了。”
content_en:
Without returning to the cave, Lin Zheng went directly to Yunchaoyuan.
"Master!"
"Master!"
"Stop screaming. Your master is not dead, so there is no need to scream."
Seeing Huo Xuan appearing in front of him like a ghost, Lin Zheng asked anxiously: "Master, have you ever heard of the Pure Brahma Fruit and Bitter Bamboo."
Huo Xuan frowned, thought for a moment and said, "I have heard of the Pure Brahma Fruit, but I have never heard of the Bitter Bamboo you mentioned. Is it useful to you?"
Lin Zheng nodded and said truthfully: "The Blood Bodhi I obtained needs to be fused with the Pure Brahma Fruit and Bitter Bamboo to prevent it from being backlashed by the Blood Bodhi."
"Who told you?"
"Master Li."
It can only be passed on to the head of the Li family, and it is impossible to reveal the identity of the tower spirit.
"I don't know about Bitter Bamboo, but the Pure Brahma Fruit is too hard to find. I will help you keep an eye out for it."
"Thank you, Master."
"Eh? Did you break through again?"
"A fluke."
Staring at Lin Zheng fiercely, Huo Xuan said with a smile: "Why is your talent so good? At the third level of foundation building, according to your cultivation speed, you might have the opportunity to start condensing the wheel in a year."
Right now.
"Elder Huoxuan, are you free?"
A tall woman wrapped in a blue tights suddenly walked in. She had sword-shaped eyebrows and starry eyes, and a small cherry mouth under the high bridge of her nose. Her appearance was heroic, like a female general coming off the battlefield.
"It turns out to be Yan Ni. He wants to refine some elixir this time."
"Breaking Wheel Pill."
Huo Xuan looked very surprised when he heard about the Wheel-Breaking Pill and asked, "Have you gathered all the ingredients for refining the Wheel-Breaking Pill?"
Yan Ni nodded, and jade boxes appeared in his hand, with about a dozen in them, and said: "This time I went out, Emperor Tian finally paid off his hard work, and I gathered all the medicinal materials. I hope Elder Huo Xuan can help me refine the Wheel-Breaking Pill."
Huo Xuan nodded and said, "Get it in three days."
"Thank you."
Putting down the jade box, Yan Ni turned and left.
"Stop looking, she is not suitable for you."
"Master, you are old and disrespectful."
Huo Xuan smiled and said: "Her name is Yan Ni, the senior sister of the Diding Sect, she is in the eighth level of Condensing Wheel. This time she got the Lun Breaking Pill. I believe she can break through to the ninth level of Condensing Wheel. She should be able to start to attack the Guiyi Realm within half a year."
"Master, is the Wheel-Breaking Pill of a very high grade?"
"For heaven-level mortals, every Condensing Wheel Realm warrior can use the Wheel-Breaking Pill to advance to a higher level. There are no side effects, but you can only swallow one."
The mortal grade is divided into four levels, the heaven and earth are black and yellow.
Heaven-level mortal elixirs are already the highest level of mortal elixirs, and the next higher level is spiritual elixirs.
"You come in with me."
"Master, I am still unable to refine heaven-level mortal elixirs."
"Nonsense, of course I know. It will be good for you to make alchemy if you come in and observe."
"Yes."
Three days later.
Yan Ni came to Yunchao Yuan early and was looking forward to it. As long as she could swallow the Lun-breaking Pill, her cultivation would be successfully promoted to the ninth level of Condensing Wheel, and she would be one step closer to the Guiyi Realm.
Creaking, the stone door opened.
Huo Xuan walked out of the alchemy room with Lin Zheng.
"Elder Huoxuan, how's it going?"
